lines.japanese: 「こんなに素敵な誕生日、初めて」
lines.english: “I’ve never had such a wonderful birthday.”

lines.japanese: はっ！？
lines.english: What?!

lines.japanese: こ、これはなんだ……誕生日？　誰の？
lines.english: Wh-what was going on...? A birthday? Whose birthday?

lines.japanese: 「ほら見て、柳木原って綺麗なんだね」
lines.english: “Look. I never knew Yanagihara could be so beautiful.”

lines.japanese: あっ！
lines.english: Ah!

lines.japanese: いまの言葉は記憶にあるぞ……これは……そうだ、あのときだ。
lines.english: I remembered those words... This was... Right, that day.

lines.japanese: 小鳩と俺がお互いの気持ちを確認して、そして関係を見つめなおそうと話した日。つまり……。
lines.english: The day Kobato and I admitted how we felt, then agreed to take a fresh look at our relationship. Which meant...

lines.japanese: 小鳩の誕生日だ！
lines.english: Kobato’s birthday!

lines.japanese: な、なんだこれは。俺は時間でも遡ってるのか。
lines.english: Wh-what was happening? Had I traveled back in time?

lines.japanese: だとしたらいまの俺は小鳩と約束をする前。愛しあっても法的に問題はない。
lines.english: If so, then this was before Kobato and I made our promise. There would be no legal problem if we made love.

lines.japanese: 「わあい、小鳩おおおおん！」
lines.english: “Yaaaay, Kobatoooo!”

lines.japanese: 「ふえっ！？　ななななにっ！」
lines.english: “Fweh?! Wh-wh-wh-what?!”

lines.japanese: この時のことはよく覚えてる。俺にとって生涯忘れられない日と言っても過言じゃない。
lines.english: I remembered that day well. It would be no exaggeration to call it one I would never forget for the rest of my life.

lines.japanese: その日の小鳩にもう一度会えるなんて、これは夢じゃないだろうか。あ、夢か？　うん、夢ならなにしてもいいか。
lines.english: I couldn't believe I was seeing the Kobato from that day again. Was this a dream? Oh, right. It probably was. And if it was a dream, anything went.

lines.japanese: 「というわけで小鳩、今すぐ愛しあおう」
lines.english: “So, Kobato, let’s make love right now.”

lines.japanese: 「あいうえっ！？　あ、ままま待っておに、お兄ちゃん。わたし今から大切なこと言おうと……」
lines.english: “Aeiouh?! W-w-wait, Big Brother. I was just about to tell you something important...”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに今日はクリスマスだけど、プレゼントは家に帰ってからでいいよ」
lines.english: “And today is Christmas, but you can give me my present once we get home.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　なんでそんなこと……あ、でもほんとだ。今日クリスマスだったんだね」
lines.english: “What?! How do you know that...? Oh, but you’re right. It is Christmas today.”

lines.japanese: 「というわけで結婚しよう！」
lines.english: “So let’s get married!”

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ！　今から！？」
lines.english: “What?! Right now?!”

lines.japanese: 「そう今から。だってこれ夢だからね。俺分かってるからね。というわけで、小鳩に好きなこと言っていいのかなって」
lines.english: “Yes, right now. This is a dream. I know it is. So I figured I could say anything I wanted to you.”

lines.japanese: 「ゆめっ？　な、なに言ってるのお兄ちゃん、これ夢じゃないよ？」
lines.english: “A dream? Wh-what are you talking about, Big Brother? This isn’t a dream.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿言うな、だって俺はこの日のことを知ってるからね。夢以外の何物でもないじゃないか」
lines.english: “Don’t be silly. I already know everything that happened on this day. What else could it be but a dream?”

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけなんで、俺には今しかないんだ。さあ愛しあおう小鳩」
lines.english: “And that means this is my only chance. Come, Kobato. Let’s make love.”

lines.japanese: 「ゆ、夢じゃないってば、夢じゃないんだよお兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “I-it isn’t a dream. This isn’t a dream, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩……あのときほんとは俺、すっごくどきどきしてたんだ」
lines.english: “Kobato... The truth is, my heart was pounding so hard that day.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん。私もいますごくどきどきしてる」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. Mine is pounding really hard right now too.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと好きだって言いたかった」
lines.english: “I’d wanted to tell you I loved you for so long.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「もうずっと抱きしめたかった。そりゃ現実があるからああ言ったけど、やっぱり俺には小鳩しか見えないんだ」
lines.english: “I’d wanted to hold you for so long. I only said what I did because we had to face reality, but you're still the only one for me.”

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃん、ずいぶんはっきり言うんだね……」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother, you’re being awfully direct...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、うん……私も好きだよ、お兄ちゃんのことが本当に大好き」
lines.english: “But... yes. I love you too, Big Brother. I truly love you.”

lines.japanese: 「困ったね」
lines.english: “What a predicament.”

lines.japanese: 「困らないさ」
lines.english: “It doesn’t have to be.”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の背中へ手を回して、その小さな体を引きよせた。
lines.english: I wrapped an arm around Kobato’s back and drew her small body close.

lines.japanese: 「ほんとは……あのときだって、冷静でいられたのはお兄ちゃんだからって意地を張ってただけなんだ。本当は我慢できずにこうやって……」
lines.english: “The truth is... even that day, I only managed to stay calm by stubbornly telling myself I had to be your big brother. What I really wanted was to give in and do this...”

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃん？　その、こんなことしてたら、周りのひとに見られちゃうよ」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother? Um, if we do this here, people will see us.”

lines.japanese: 「見られちゃうって、周りに誰もいないじゃないか。そんな心配しなくていいんだよ」
lines.english: “See us? There’s no one around. You don’t need to worry.”

lines.japanese: 「だ、だって今は居なくてもすぐに誰か来るよ。怒られちゃうよ……？」
lines.english: “B-but even if no one’s here now, someone will come soon. We’ll get in trouble...”

lines.japanese: 「だからそんなのいいんだよ。俺は小鳩とずっとこうしたかった、抱きしめたかったんだよ！」
lines.english: “That doesn’t matter. I’ve always wanted to do this with you. I’ve always wanted to hold you!”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……」
lines.english: “Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなこと言われたって……ずるいよお兄ちゃん、私だって大好きなのに……」
lines.english: “Y-you can’t say things like that... It isn’t fair. I love you too...”

lines.japanese: 「ダメだって分かってても、逆らえなくなっちゃうよ……」
lines.english: “Even though I know we shouldn’t, I won’t be able to resist...”

lines.japanese: 「いいんだ小鳩、いまはお兄ちゃんのことを信じてくれ」
lines.english: “That’s all right, Kobato. For now, trust your big brother.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん、ほんとにいいのかな……ひあっ！？」
lines.english: “O-okay. Is this really all right...? Eek?!”

lines.japanese: いいんだよ。そう言う前に、小鳩の首筋にキスして、これ以上の反論をさせないようにした。
lines.english: It’s all right. Before I could say the words, I kissed Kobato’s neck and cut off any further objection.
“Kobato...”

lines.japanese: ううっ、気づかいどころか、本当に幸せそうな笑顔を向けてくれるなんて……俺はこの夢が覚めないことを心から祈って……。
lines.english: Oh, God. She wasn't just humoring me—she looked genuinely happy... I prayed with all my heart that I would never wake from this dream...

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　まだ覚めないの？」
lines.english: “Huh? Why haven't I woken up yet?”

lines.japanese: 俺はふと周りの空気のリアルさが気になって、首をぐるんと回してみた。
lines.english: The realism of the air around me suddenly bothered me, and I swung my head all the way around.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なにが？」
lines.english: “What? Waking up from what?”

lines.japanese: 「いやだってこれ、夢だから……最後までいったなら、もうそろそろ終わってもいいんじゃないかなって」
lines.english: “Well, this is a dream... We went all the way, so I thought it should end about now.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　まだ言ってるのお兄ちゃん？　これ夢じゃないよ」
lines.english: “What? Are you still saying that, Big Brother? This isn’t a dream.”

lines.japanese: はい？
lines.english: Excuse me?

lines.japanese: 「えっ、夢じゃないの！？」
lines.english: “Wait, this isn't a dream?!”

lines.japanese: え、待って待って。確かに夢にしちゃ小鳩も存在感ありすぎるけど、これ現実！？
lines.english: Wait, wait. Kobato did feel much too real for a dream, but this was reality?!

lines.japanese: あ、あわわわわ、だとしたら俺はとんでもないことをしでかしてしまったんじゃ……！　このままじゃ、ぜんぜん成長してなかったことになるじゃないか！
lines.english: A-awawawawa! Then hadn’t I done something absolutely terrible?! This would mean I had not grown at all!

lines.japanese: 「だから私、ずっと夢じゃないって言ってたのに」
lines.english: “I kept telling you it wasn’t a dream.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いやだって、ええっ！？　え、これマジで？　ドッキリじゃなくて？　じゃあ俺、どうすれば――」
lines.english: “What? But—what?! Is this serious? Not a prank? Then what am I supposed to—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、時間だ」
lines.english: “Oh. It’s time.”

lines.japanese: 「時間っ！？」
lines.english: “Time?!”

lines.japanese: 「ピッ、ピッ、ピッ」
lines.english: “Beep, beep, beep.”

lines.japanese: 「時報ーん」
lines.english: “Time-sig-naaal!”

lines.japanese: 「えええええっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: こ、この曲は……コンドルさんの番組のテーマソング……？
lines.english: Th-this music... Wasn’t it the theme song from Mr. Condor’s program...?

lines.japanese: 「ってことは……つまり……」
lines.english: “Which means... in other words...”

lines.japanese: なるほど、そういうことか。ああ、やけにリアルだと思ったよ。
lines.english: I see. So that was it. No wonder it felt unusually real.

lines.japanese: 夢じゃないけど夢テレビってね。ははは、参ったなこりゃ。
lines.english: It wasn’t a dream, but it was dream television. Hahaha. Well, they got me.

lines.japanese: 「ってふざけんなああああ！」
lines.english: “Like hell that makes it okay!”

lines.japanese: 「ずっといっしょだよ、お兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “We'll always be together, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、こら！　なにひとの大切な思い出のセリフ言ってるんだ！　ちょ待て、なんだこれふざけるな。テメエ！　ちょっと出てこいコンドルさんコラアー！」
lines.english: “Hey! Don't steal a line from one of my precious memories! Hold on—what the hell is this? Cut the crap, you bastard! Get your ass out here, Mr. Condor!”

lines.japanese: コンドルさんはいつだって僕たちの隙を窺っています。テレビの前のみんなも気を付けましょう。
lines.english: Mr. Condor is always watching for a moment of weakness. Everyone at home should be careful too.
